parameters.content:
## Setup (replace before activating)
Find & replace in this file BEFORE importing:
- `__SUPABASE_URL__` -> https://YOUR-REF.supabase.co
- `__ADVISOR_CALENDAR_ID__` -> `primary` or the advisor's calendar email
- `__SLACK_CHANNEL_ID__` -> the Slack channel ID (e.g. C0123456789)

Credentials to attach after import: Header Auth (name `x-vapi-secret`) on the 4 webhooks, Supabase API (service role) on Supabase nodes, Google Calendar OAuth2 on the 2 calendar-API nodes, Slack on the Slack node.

### A. upsert_lead
Saves/updates the buyer row. DB trigger re-scores. Returns tier + NEXT step to the voice agent.

### B. check_availability
Google Calendar freeBusy -> up to 3 open 30-min slots (Mon-Fri 9-5 ET, 3h notice). Edit hours in the 'Compute Slots' node.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ timeMin: $json.timeMin, timeMax: $json.timeMax, timeZone: 'America/New_York', items: [{ id: 'primary' }] }) }}

parameters.content:
### C. book_appointment
Re-checks the slot is still free -> creates Google Calendar event (invite emailed if lead gave an email) -> marks lead booked -> saves appointment -> posts hot-lead details to Slack -> tells the agent.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ timeMin: $('Parse Booking').first().json.start, timeMax: $('Parse Booking').first().json.end, timeZone: 'America/New_York', items: [{ id: 'primary' }] }) }}

const p = $('Prepare Post-Booking').first().json;
return [{ json: { toolCallId: p.toolCallId, result: `Booked for ${p.when}. Confirm the day and time to the caller and tell them an advisor will call them then.` } }];

const c = $('Build Event').first().json;
return [{ json: { toolCallId: c.toolCallId, result: 'Booking failed. Do not retry. Tell the caller a team member will call them shortly to schedule, and note that with upsert_lead.' } }];
